identity: The Battlegrounds' war camps of both factions, mining camps of the Miner's Guild since Round 58: their foremen's quests.

quests.title: The Supply Run Bites Back
quests.text: Sinkmire Vipers have made carrying water through the reeds an occupation requiring entirely too many eyes. Hunt eight Sinkmire Vipers by day in the {name:reedmire}, which lies {zone_area:reedmire}. The camp needs the water, and I would like to stop sending escorts out for buckets.

variants.text: Sinkmire Vipers have made carrying water through the reeds an occupation requiring entirely too many eyes. Hunt eight Sinkmire Vipers by day in the {name:reedmire}, which lies {zone_area:reedmire}. The camp needs the water, and I would like to stop sending escorts out for buckets.

Deserters have been ambushing our haulers before their supplies reach camp. Defeat eight Deserters by day on the {name:approaches}, which lie {zone_area:approaches}. Every stolen load leaves both a guard and a worker waiting for something they need.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L41-43) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.

quests.title: Work Under Fire
quests.text: Tallow-Sealed Husks keep driving our supply carriers off the open ground. Defeat eight Tallow-Sealed Husks by day in the {name:toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:toll_fields}. The camp cannot eat a schedule, however often I rewrite it.

variants.text: Tallow-Sealed Husks keep driving our supply carriers off the open ground. Defeat eight Tallow-Sealed Husks by day in the {name:toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:toll_fields}. The camp cannot eat a schedule, however often I rewrite it.

Turncoat Archers have been taking shots at the workers hauling supplies through the breach. Defeat eight Turncoat Archers by day in the {name:breach}, which lies {zone_area:breach}. Our people need a clear run to camp, and crouching behind the load is getting them nowhere.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L48-50) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.
